name.en-US: The Consolation of the Poor and the Sick
name.pt-BR: A Consolação dos Pobres e Enfermos

description.la: Consolatio pauperum et infirmorum: dialogus brevis octo articulis, ad pauperem, debilem, Lazarum infirmum, Ioseph peregrinum, claudum despectum, Columbanum tacitum, Simplicianum indoctum et turturem solitarium.
description.en-US: A short book of comfort in eight addresses, to the poor man, the weak, sick Lazarus, Joseph the stranger, the despised cripple, Columban the silent, Simplicianus the unlearned and the solitary turtle-dove. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Pequeno livro de consolação em oito exortações: ao pobre, ao fraco, a Lázaro enfermo, a José peregrino, ao coxo desprezado, a Columbano calado, a Simpliciano ignorante e à rola solitária.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Consolatio pauperum et infirmorum, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: Pohl's text without his critical apparatus and introduction; line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script. Raw OCR: drop capitals at openings are often garbled, and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
